title: CONTROLLER RUMBLE
why: His pick from the feature list. Each player controller buzzes when that player is hit, harder for a bigger hit, goes down, or is near a blast, with a light tick when firing. On one PC the player 2 buzz is sent to the window that reads his controller. A Settings row turns it off, and a controller nobody is using never buzzes.
now: CONTROLLER RUMBLE, his pick from the feature list. Each player controller buzzes when that player is hit (harder for a bigger hit), goes down or is near a blast, with a light tick when firing; on one PC the player 2 buzz goes to the window that reads his controller. Settings has a Controller rumble row, On by default, and a controller nobody has touched for a minute stays still.
